_comment: Live source list for the learning wiki. youtube_channels and essay_sources are read by OpenWiki (wikiblocks). The other keys are read by tools/wiki.py. authority: non-negotiable = house standard, applied and locked in every project, changed only when the person explicitly asks; good-to-have = recommended default; reference = trusted learning material that informs options, heuristics, visual samples and process. Raw transcripts and page text live in learn/raw/ and are git-ignored (third-party content is never committed); the wiki pages and analysis JSON derived from them are committed.
